title: feat: Phase 3a - Replace wrangler utility imports with local packages
body:
#### Problem:

The Harvester codebase imports ~200 files from `github.com/rancher/wrangler/v3` utility packages for basic operations like string splitting, condition management, name sanitization, scheme registration, and signal handling. These are simple utilities that create an unnecessary dependency on the Rancher ecosystem.

This is Phase 3a of the vanilla Kubernetes migration (continuing from PR #1 which removed RKE2 infrastructure and Rancher API types).

#### Solution:

Replace wrangler utility packages with local equivalents under `pkg/util/` or Go stdlib:

| Wrangler Package | Replacement | Files Changed |
|---|---|---|
| `wrangler/v3/pkg/kv` | `pkg/util/kv` | ~20 |
| `wrangler/v3/pkg/condition` | `pkg/util/condition` | ~10 |
| `wrangler/v3/pkg/genericcondition` | `pkg/util/genericcondition` | ~10 |
| `wrangler/v3/pkg/name` | `pkg/util/name` | ~5 |
| `wrangler/v3/pkg/schemes` | `pkg/util/schemes` | ~5 |
| `wrangler/v3/pkg/gvk` | `pkg/util/gvk` | internal only |
| `wrangler/v3/pkg/ratelimit` | `pkg/util/ratelimit` | ~3 |
| `wrangler/v3/pkg/patch` | `pkg/util/patch` | 3 |
| `wrangler/v3/pkg/slice` | `slices` (Go stdlib) | 8 |
| `wrangler/v3/pkg/signals` | `signal.NotifyContext` (Go stdlib) | 2 |

All local packages provide API-compatible replacements. The `condition` package preserves the reflection-based approach for backward compatibility with existing CRD status types.

**Remaining wrangler imports** (for future phases):
- `generated/controllers/*` (~154 uses) - wrangler-generated K8s controllers
- `generic` (~55 uses) - controller type interfaces  
- `schemas/*` (~21 uses) - steve API framework
- `apply`, `webhook`, `relatedresource` (~20 uses) - framework utilities

#### Related Issue(s):

Continuation of PR #1 (vanilla K8s migration)

#### Test plan:

1. `go build ./...` passes clean with zero errors
2. All import replacements are API-compatible (same function signatures)
3. No behavioral changes - only import path changes

#### Additional documentation or context

**50 files changed**, 712 insertions, 60 deletions. Build verified clean.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/c1b9b0ecbe6b46ad8e59692a363b5f8a
Requested by: @Exonical
